rendered: The strain is R82, an osmotic-tolerant derivative of SDSPY-136, obtained by adaptive laboratory evolution:[1] The parent strain was evolved for 120 generations under high osmotic pressure[2] to give the tolerant strain R82[3]. Its prodigiosin titer of 11.4[4] g/L was reached in a fermentation at this scale: In 5 L fed-batch fermentation[5], where R82 reached about double the original strain's yield. Table 2[6] gives the same strain's titer as 11,400[7] mg/L after 48[8] h, but lists the cultivation mode as shake flask[9], which conflicts with the fed-batch scale given in the prose.
